report_name: Booba Project Ransomware Claims Attack on NY Healthcare Provider

threat_actors.name: Booba Project
threat_actors.description: A double-extortion ransomware group that claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Associated Gastroenterologists of Central New York, P.C., alleging the exfiltration of 70 GB of sensitive data.
threat_actors.goals: To extort money from victims by encrypting files and threatening to leak stolen sensitive data.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors likely used credential dumping techniques to escalate privileges and move laterally across the network to access critical data stores.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: The Booba Project group exfiltrated 70 GB of data to an external server under their control before deploying the ransomware payload.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Booba Project executed their ransomware payload to encrypt files across the network of Associated Gastroenterologists of Central New York.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The ransomware actors likely deleted backups or Volume Shadow Copies using tools like wmic.exe to hinder recovery efforts.

malware.name: Booba Project Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the Booba Project group to encrypt files on the victim's network and facilitate a double-extortion scheme.

tools.name: wmic.exe
tools.description: Used to delete Volume Shadow Copies to inhibit system recovery before file encryption.

identities.name: Associated Gastroenterologists of Central New York, P.C.
identities.description: A medical practice based in New York that was targeted by the Booba Project ransomware group, resulting in a data breach involving 70 GB of patient and employee data.

infrastructure.name: Booba Project Dark Web Leak Site
infrastructure.description: The dark web site where the Booba Project group posted its claim of the attack and threatened to publish the 70 GB of stolen data.

infrastructure.name: Data Exfiltration Server
infrastructure.description: An external server controlled by the Booba Project used to store the 70 GB of data exfiltrated from the victim's network.

indicators.name: WMIC Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: WMIC Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 9c5b1f3a-6d8e-4b0c-8a1f-9e2d7c4b0a1e
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of wmic.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-03
references:
  - https://www.classaction.org/data-breach-lawsuits/associated-gastroenterologists-of-central-new-york-october-2026
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of wmic.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: Ransom Note File Creation
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Ransom Note File Creation
id: 8d4a2b1c-7e9f-4a0b-9c2d-8e1f7a6b5c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of common ransom note files dropped by ransomware.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-03
references:
  - https://www.classaction.org/data-breach-lawsuits/associated-gastroenterologists-of-central-new-york-october-2026
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\readme.txt'
      - '\decrypt_me.html'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of common ransom note files.
